editorial.hero_description: A rainforest eco-lodge and adventure park on the slopes of the Rincón de la Vieja volcano.
editorial.description: Buena Vista del Rincón is an eco adventure park, hotel and spa nestled in the rainforest foothills of the Rincón de la Vieja volcano in Guanacaste. With 76 rooms, natural volcanic hot springs, and an on-site adventure park, it blends thrill and relaxation in a lush mountain setting.

why_stay_here.title: Why Stay Here
why_stay_here.summary: Buena Vista del Rincón is one of the best places to stay if you want to combine comfort with unforgettable experiences around Guanacaste.

wellness.reason: Volcanic hot springs, natural sauna and mud baths, with a dedicated Wellness Travelers profile.

adventure_access.reason: On-site adventure park with zip line, 420-meter water slide, hanging bridges and horseback riding; Adventure Seekers profile calls it a full day of adrenaline.

wild_insights.local_take: Ideal for active travelers and families who want ziplining, waterfalls and volcanic hot springs all in one place. The unpaved access road can be tricky for small rental cars, so consider a private transfer.

faq.q: Does the hotel have natural volcanic hot springs?
faq.a: Yes, the hotel features crystal-clear volcanic hot springs, a natural sauna, mineral-rich volcanic mud baths and cold pools set within a private wildlife refuge.

faq.q: Do I need to stay overnight to enjoy the hot springs and activities?
faq.a: Not necessarily. Day Passes are available for visitors who want to enjoy the hot springs, volcanic spa and Eco Adventure Park without staying overnight.

faq.q: Do you offer airport transportation from Liberia?
faq.a: Yes, both private and shared transfers from Liberia International Airport (LIR) can be arranged in advance via WhatsApp or the reservations team.
